checks: unsupported producer fallback uses plain text, never changes screen/cursor modes, and restores termios
one transmitted KGP image renders correct red/blue pixels at two native scene references
XRes measures one 2048-byte server pixmap for two image references
mouse click emits only a surface/revision/node-bound action, with no PTY mouse bytes
button focus consumes ordinary text and Tab; Enter emits one structured action
Escape returns ordinary typing to the PTY and consumes its own gesture
view-only font zoom works during button focus, cancels captured geometry and consumes release
drag/release outside a button never activates or leaks a mouse gesture
focus loss cancels a captured click while still consuming its release
a revision change between press and release cancels activation and consumes release
malformed and oversized payloads preserve revision 2 and recover for the following VT traffic
retransmitting the same KGP ID refreshes both scene references without a scene update
pane resize invalidates the captured hit and relayout restores actual image pixels
alternate-screen transition clears the surface and cancels a pending gesture
RIS clears surface/actions; revision floor survives and a fresh scene can be drawn
explicit clear removes image UI and cancels the captured click
events:false previews the scene but never emits an action
narrow text leaf renders visible glyphs while clipping combining ink at both horizontal bounds
native press -> tab change -> other-view motion/release never reaches either PTY; reporting resumes after release
release outside every ztty view is observed by a separate X client; return motion retires stale capture and reaches the PTY
an observer cannot emit action intents or ordinary PTY input
PTY EOF clears the surface and leaves no actionable retained UI
shipped Python producer negotiates supported ZUI/1 and renders its actual generated image
real click -> producer action decoder -> revision update reaches 100% native progress pixels
